market.question: Will Venezuelan crude oil production reach 1.3m barrels per day in 2026?

assessment.reasoning: OPEC secondary-source ~988k b/d March 2026. Reaching 1.3M requires +32% ramp — historically Venezuela has not added that much in a calendar year given infrastructure decay, despite some sanctions easing. Less likely than 1.2M.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major sanctions relief plus Chevron expansion could surprise upside; baseline still well below 1.3M.
